S6:10.text: And he begat three ſonnes, Sem, Cham, and Iapheth.

S6:11.text: And the earth was corrupted before God, & was repleniſhed with iniquitie.

S6:12.text: And when God had perceiued that the earth was corrupted (for al fleſh had corrupted his way vpon the earth)

S6:13.text: he ſaid to Noc: The end of al fleſh is come before me, the earth is repleniſhed with iniquitie from the face of them, and I wil deſtroy them with the earth.

S6:14.text: Make thee an arke of timber planke: cabinets ſhalt thou make in the arke, and ſhalt pitch it within and without with bitume.

S6:15.text: And thus ſhalt thou make it. The length of the Arke ſhal be three hundred cubits: fiftie cubits the breadth, and thirtie cubits the height of it.

S6:16.text: Thou ſhalt make a window in the arke, & in a cubit finiſh the top of it: & the dore of the arke thou ſhalt ſet at the ſide below, middle chambers & third lofts ſhalt thou make in it.

S6:18.text: And I wil eſtabliſh my couenant with thee: and thou ſhalt enter into the arke thou and thy ſonnes and thy wife, and the wiues of thy ſonnes with thee.
